overview:
Republican Jake Ellzey seeks re-election in a North Texas district that voted Republican by about eleven points at the presidential level. He enters the general election with a large financial edge, having raised roughly $4.7 million and holding $2.5 million on hand, while Democrat Danny Minton has raised about $44,000. No outside groups are spending against the incumbent.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, money, and prediction markets, which price a Democratic win at only about one percent. The seat is rated Likely Republican, with Ellzey favored by roughly fifteen points.
